verdict.rationale: Porkbun offers a full REST/JSON API for domains, DNS, SSL, hosting, and WordPress that can be used entirely headlessly with API keys (not requiring interactive login even with 2FA enabled), plus a sandbox mode, idempotency keys, dry-run flags, and webhooks for event-driven automation — all well suited to CI/agentic workflows. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation of CI usage, and no official OpenAPI spec or SDK verified (openapi probes 404).
